subject.title: fix(release): make advisory acceptance summaries portable on macOS

question: Should this maintainer-labeled release-workflow change land after an inspectable exact-head macOS Bash 3.2 proof confirms the reported seven-test recovery?
rationale: The implementation is deliberately narrow, but the available evidence is a prose claim rather than an inspectable real-environment result, and the protected label requires explicit human handling.

options.title: Request macOS proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted terminal transcript or screenshot from Bash 3.2 without `timeout` or `gtimeout` that shows the after-fix focused workflow result.

options.title: Accept the reported run
options.body: A maintainer may accept the stated macOS result without additional artifact evidence if they independently trust the contributor's release-validation record.

recommendation.title: Request macOS proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted terminal transcript or screenshot from Bash 3.2 without `timeout` or `gtimeout` that shows the after-fix focused workflow result.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work and this follow-up both cover the release-acceptance workflow and its focused test harness.
